description: technical-team hooks: the guard (PreToolUse) enforces write ownership, per-role shell policy, lead-only delegation, the hire approval gate (a new HIRE-APPROVED line in .team/STATE.md always raises a permission prompt) and per-role skill lists; the handoff check (SubagentStop) sends a team agent back when it ends without the handoff block (or the lead without its report); the activity hook (SubagentStart, cleared at SubagentStop) records which team agents are running in .team/.live/ for the status command. Calls from your own main session are otherwise not affected.
